pairs: and seventy elders out of Israel,
And only Moses will ascend to the Lord,
Neither shall the people ascend with him.”
Venit ergo Moyses et narravit plebi omnia verba Domini,
Moses went and explained to the people all the words of the Lord,
And all the people responded with one voice:
“We will do all the words of the Lord,
Scripsit autem Moyses universos sermones Domini:
Then Moses wrote all the words of the Lord.
And rising up in the morning,
he built an altar at the base of the mountain,
et duodecim titulos per duodecim tribus Israël.
with twelve titles according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
And he sent youths from the sons of Israel,
and they immolated calves as peace-offerings to the Lord.
Tulit itaque Moyses dimidiam partem sanguinis,
And so Moses took one half part of the blood,
and he put it into bowls.
partem autem residuam fudit super altare.
Then the remaining part he poured over the altar.
And taking up the book of the covenant,
he read it in the hearing of the people,
Ille vero sumptum sanguinem respersit in populum,
In truth, taking up the blood, he sprinkled it on the people,
Hic est sanguis fœderis quod pepigit Dominus vobiscum super cunctis sermonibus his.
“This is the blood of the covenant, which the Lord has formed with you concerning all these words.”
and seventy of the elders of Israel ascended.
And they saw the God of Israel.
et sub pedibus ejus quasi opus lapidis sapphirini,
And under his feet was something like a work of sapphire stone,
Nec super eos qui procul recesserant de filiis Israël, misit manum suam,
Neither did he lay his hand upon those of the sons of Israel who were at a distance.
Then the Lord said to Moses:
And I will give to you tablets of stone,
and the commandments that I have written.
Surrexerunt Moyses et Josue minister ejus:
Moses rose up, with Joshua his minister. And Moses,
ascending on the mountain of God,
Expectate hic donec revertamur ad vos.
You have Aaron and Hur with you.
you shall refer it to them.”
et habitavit gloria Domini super Sinai,
And the glory of the Lord dwelt upon Sinai,
covering it with a cloud for six days.
septimo autem die vocavit eum de medio caliginis.
And on the seventh day, he called to him from the middle of the mist.
Erat autem species gloriæ Domini quasi ignis ardens super verticem montis in conspectu filiorum Israël.
Now the appearance of the glory of the Lord was like a burning fire over the summit of the mountain in the sight of the sons of Israel.
entering into the midst of the cloud,
And he was there for forty days and forty nights.
